data.name: Gnomicide
data.detailed_description:
Gnomes have overrun the realm. It's time to clean up.

  • A short, sweet and polished experience.

  • Kill 50,000 gnomes in this stress relieving, atmospheric "clean up" game.

  • Explore your dark fantasy backyard and discover hidden secrets.

  • Crush, punch, throw, and body slam gnomes with an array of abilities.

  • Unlock new weapons as you clean out the gnome infestation.

Wishlist our game for future updates and release info!
